title: Shreya Episode 06 — Society twins rematch, sister study and next police training round
authorDirection: Shreya's Uncle discoveries and Shreya–Vikram intimate marriage closing already happened in Episode05; do not repeat. Episode06 runs Saturday 3 through Monday 5 January 2026. Shreya is on police duty all three days, not on approved leave: Saturday 08:30–16:30, Sunday shorter roster 08:00–13:00, Monday 08:00–17:00. The Saturday gym competition occurs before duty at 06:20–07:30; sister study and Ankita evidence comparison take place after her shift; Sunday flat study begins at 15:00; Monday station training is 10:30–11:20. Samar–Shaan beat Shreya in separate gym rematches; they revive old lighthearted wagers, then request exam-study guidance. Shreya recruits her sister Shruti for the four-person IAS/competitive-exam study circle. A private changing-room sightline accident follows the workout: Samar and Shaan momentarily see Shreya in her bra, Shreya notices and secures privacy; their established rapport continues. Bachelor twin flat is an established user-directed recurring study setting. Karan–Aman are prior Shreya acquaintances but held outside this three-day active plot. Existing police unit continues its professional training with an advanced new drill, not another flag-capture replay.

sceneOrder.title: Saturday · Samar–Shaan win rematches, ask for exam mentoring; changing-room accident
sceneOrder.location: Gulmohar Heights gym / adjoining private changing cubicle
sceneOrder.purpose: Cash in earlier plank/balance bets with new result, create a real reason for study group, and establish one distinct brief accidental changing-area sightline.
existingAnchors: Episode02 SR01 06:55–07:28 on 1 Jan: Shreya won Samar's two-minute plank and Shaan's single-leg balance competition; Samar's coffee bet and Shaan's tentative saree/get-together condition remain unresolved and subject to their mutual teasing.

Episode03 1 Jan ~5:19 PM: during resistance-band recovery Samar supported Shreya's upper back and outer arm, Shaan her clothed side-waist, with immediate release; no breast touch or changing-room view in that approved scene.
Samar is expressive and playful; Shaan is quieter and precise. Both are adults, brothers and already familiar training partners.

Saturday Ankita × Shreya evidence comparison is shifted to 17:40–18:00 AFTER Shreya's 08:30–16:30 station duty; they are NOT physically meeting in the morning. Karan–Aman and Ayaan–Armaan are excluded from the gym scene.

beats.title: 06:20–06:35 · Distinct rematches
beats.action: Samar wins the two-minute plank variation and Shaan wins a controlled single-leg balance rematch on merit; Shreya's competitive teasing and their established rapport continue. Do not replay the earlier resistance-band rescue.

beats.title: 06:35–06:47 · Old wager banter
beats.action: Samar reopens his coffee appeal; Shaan reminds Shreya of the earlier conditional saree/get-together remark. The twins mischievously build suspense about what they will ask before revealing their real request.

beats.title: 06:47–07:00 · Genuine ask
beats.action: The brothers ask Shreya to mentor them for IAS/competitive examinations, with interview/current-affairs study and physical fitness as appropriate. Shreya remembers Shruti is preparing too and agrees to form a four-person study group, conditional only on practical duty scheduling.

beats.title: 07:10–07:17 · Changing-area accident
beats.action: After the workout Shreya changes in a separate cubicle. Its latch does not catch completely; as she adjusts her clothes, the door opens briefly onto the passage while Samar and Shaan pass to collect gym equipment. Both unexpectedly see Shreya in her bra. Samar's talk stops, Shaan looks away and alerts her; Shreya notices the door, closes it properly and later says she will check the latch next time. It is an unintended brief sightline, not a planned display or invitation.

beats.title: 07:17–07:30 · Exit and continuity
beats.action: She is dressed before continuing the conversation. No confrontation, ongoing humiliation, second accident or abrupt breakup of the friendship. Confirm group-study follow-up with Shruti later, then each leaves via an ordinary separate route.

sceneOrder.title: Saturday evening · Shreya and Shruti settle study goals after station duty
sceneOrder.purpose: Make Shruti independently invested in preparation and arrange next day's four-person meeting without inventing Shreya's fixed police shift.

beats.title: Sisters' opening
beats.action: Shreya tells Shruti how the two brothers finally won their gym rematches and asks about Shruti's preparation. Their familiar teasing, confidence and affection remain distinct from the twins' banter.

beats.title: Exam preparation split
beats.action: Clarify which exam each adult is actually preparing for before claiming a shared syllabus: IAS/UPSC written/interview versus police or military recruitment physical criteria. Shreya can mentor interview mindset, study discipline and fitness without asserting she personally qualified as IAS.

beats.title: Sunday arrangement
beats.action: Shruti accepts a four-person study meeting. Samar and Shaan's shared bachelor flat is the first candidate venue with a usable quiet living room; contact and address are not invented. Confirm Anaya's household care separately.

sceneOrder.title: Sunday · Shreya–Shruti–Samar–Shaan first home study session
sceneOrder.location: Samar–Shaan shared bachelor apartment · living-room study table
sceneOrder.purpose: Establish a repeatable home-study channel, separate from gym competition and official station rounds.
existingAnchors: Samar and Shaan are bachelor roommates living alone in their shared apartment (new user direction).
Shreya's duty roster varies; future sessions cannot be assumed daily at the same time.
Karan–Aman are booked separately for Shivani late morning and Kavya late afternoon as candidate Sunday holds. They do not attend this scene.

beats.title: Arrive and settle
beats.action: The twins welcome the two women to their shared apartment. Establish only its private living-room study setting; no arbitrary roommates or family visitors.

beats.title: Four different learning goals
beats.action: Shreya asks each learner for their strengths; Samar leads energetic discussion, Shaan works methodically, Shruti answers boldly and questions them. Build teasing through character differences, not instant relationship claims.

beats.title: First concrete study material
beats.action: One short current-affairs/constitutional-reasoning set, explanation of a mock answer, and a simple written revision schedule. Competitive-exam questions are chosen after individual exam types are confirmed.

beats.title: Future workouts
beats.action: Agree to continue gym and running drills separately, rotating the location among the twins' apartment, Shreya's home and the existing society common area by permission and convenience. No duplicate changing-area accident.

beats.title: Group exit
beats.action: Shreya and Shruti return on their own schedule. No sudden forced intimacy, no planned undressing. Leave some natural mutual interest/awkward humour for future scenes.

sceneOrder.title: Monday · new controlled police training round and colleague viewpoints
sceneOrder.location: Existing police station training area, not society gym
sceneOrder.purpose: Move beyond the already-written flag-control challenge by adding purposeful close-contact defensive techniques, more demanding teamwork and distinct female officer perspectives; no replay of 1 Jan touching incidents.
existingAnchors: 1 Jan published Beat 10 15:40–16:05: flag-control and contested cone/tag runs. Kavita wins first; Meera and Kavita collide briefly with Rohas/Lokesh, whose rescue supports end immediately. Those exact incidents are not repeated.
Meera 24 trainee; Kavita 23 constable; Rohas and Lokesh 24 male trainees, not biological twins. Poonam 29 Sub-Inspector, Anjali 36 personnel/admin.
This is police training, not a sexual practice drill. A later private fitness request is a different optional plot lane, not something already carried out here.

beats.title: 10:30–10:35 · Next-round premise
beats.action: Shreya acknowledges Kavita's previous flag win; new exercise changes from tag-grabbing to a controlled two-person escape/hold-break technique on padded mats. Each participant knows its stop signal.

beats.title: 10:35–10:45 · Rohas + Meera
beats.action: Rohas plays the resistance partner, Meera rehearses forearm/shoulder framing and safe disengagement. She asks for a harder second attempt and earns it by escaping cleanly. Their competitive energy is stronger than in the previous flag run; contact is technique-driven.

beats.title: 10:45–10:55 · Lokesh + Kavita
beats.action: Kavita rehearses counterbalance and a controlled fall-recovery with Lokesh. Their positions come closer for the hold-break but the exercise ends on the release cue. She finishes with a tactical improvement rather than another clothing mishap.

beats.title: 10:55–11:05 · Rotated challenge
beats.action: Partners swap briefly, so each trainee solves a new technique: a two-step grip escape and coordinated recovery. Shreya corrects foot placement and safety; no repetition of yesterday's same waist/hip rescue.

beats.title: 11:05–11:15 · Female perspectives
beats.action: Meera notices her confidence in direct contact has improved; Kavita notices Rohas adapts to her speed; Shreya evaluates measured restraint. Keep their emotional intensity in competition and professional trust rather than invented consent.

beats.title: 11:15–11:20 · Supervisor and future private request
beats.action: Poonam reviews training results, Anjali notes a possible separately organized off-duty fitness session requested by women colleagues. Any separate private practice will be planned later with each adult's own choice, location and timetable; it is not Monday's official round.

beats.action: Share mock-question homework and next available study date over a short group call. No scene if Shreya is still on shift.
